name: ansi
title: ANSI
description: parseAnsi and stripAnsi read a line of terminal output in one linear pass: SGR codes (the 16 colours, 256 colours and truecolor in the semicolon and colon forms, bold, dim, italic, underline, inverse, strikethrough, reset) become styled runs, and every other escape sequence, OSC string (titles, hyperlinks), control character and bidi override is dropped; a carriage return redraws the line. The text comes back as strings, never markup. ansiCssColor maps a terminal colour to theme-aware CSS that clamps its lightness to --ansi-lightness-min and --ansi-lightness-max, for 4.5:1 on muted in light and dark.
